🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION, not broad risk-on or risk-off. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. VXX falling (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -19.92%) BELOW TREND and SPY ABOVE TREND (SPY (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +2.57%) ABOVE TREND) confirm equity bid while HYG/LQD shows mixed credit signals (HYG (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND; LQD (1W: +0.20% | 1M: -0.16%) RECOVERY), supporting a rotation narrative.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -19.92%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Reflation/reopening bid: CPER (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising. Credit mixed but marginally supportive: HYG (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND → flat.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-easing: SPY/TLT (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +4.45%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND while TLT (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -2.04%) BELOW TREND and UUP (1W: -0.32% | 1M: -1.48%) BELOW TREND point to looser local conditions.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals and commodities leading: Financials (XLF (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%)) ABOVE TREND and Materials/Industrials (Materials (1W: +3.44% | 1M: +8.35%)) ABOVE TREND showing strength; Tech (XLK (1W: +3.68% | 1M: +4.65%)) is ABOVE TREND but rotation into cyclicals is visible. Defensives weak: Utilities (XLU (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -2.94%)) BELOW TREND and Staples (XLP (1W: -0.42% | 1M: +1.02%)) CORRECTION showing relative weakness.

5. US vs Global?
US leadership intact: SPY (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +2.57%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +2.60%) ABOVE TREND. EM catching up: EEM (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND while China FXI (1W: +1.88% | 1M: -0.62%) RECOVERY — regional rotation, not uniform tailwind.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation cooling: Speculation Index falling and VXX down, yet small caps and thematic risk remain active — IWM (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +2.91%) ABOVE TREND, ARKK (1W: +1.28% | 1M: +3.10%) ABOVE TREND, IBIT (1W: +3.44% | 1M: +0.10%) ABOVE TREND.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Commodities-led reflation: CPER (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND, GLD (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +9.65%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +19.89% | 1M: +52.39%) ABOVE TREND — metals and industrial commodities showing strong momentum.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy mixed but constructive: XLE (1W: +1.01% | 1M: +0.61%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -1.51%) RECOVERY; Natural gas volatile: UNG (1W: +6.48% | 1M: -7.38%) RECOVERY — monitor seasonality/volatility.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Broad sector breadth (8/11) and SPY/QQQ/IWM ABOVE TREND support the rotation regime. DIVERGENCE: XLY (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +4.79%) CORRECTION, XLP (1W: -0.42% | 1M: +1.02%) CORRECTION and several bond ETFs (LQD (1W: +0.20% | 1M: -0.16%) RECOVERY) show short-term mismatches — overall a minor-to-moderate divergence set, not a regime break.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals and commodity exposure (XLF (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%) ABOVE TREND; CPER (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to defensives (XLU (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -2.94%) BELOW TREND) while monitoring credit (HYG (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND) and volatility (VXX (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -19.92%) BELOW TREND).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Materials/Industrials — DBB/Materials (Materials (1W: +3.44% | 1M: +8.35%)) ABOVE TREND; Financials — XLF (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Utilities — XLU (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -2.94%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Staples — XLP (1W: -0.42% | 1M: +1.02%) CORRECTION.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Silver SLV (1W: +19.89% | 1M: +52.39%) ABOVE TREND and Platinum PPLT (1W: +25.55% | 1M: +55.74%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH/Volatile: Natural Gas UNG (1W: +6.48% | 1M: -7.38%) RECOVERY and Brent BNO (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -1.51%) RECOVERY.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (VXX (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -19.92%) BELOW TREND) — complacency pivot; HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health signal; HYG (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND; LQD (1W: +0.20% | 1M: -0.16%) RECOVERY); XLK/XLF ~2.0 as rotation pivot (XLK (1W: +3.68% | 1M: +4.65%) ABOVE TREND; XLF (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%) ABOVE TREND).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive and VXX falling (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -19.92%) support a sector-rotation regime. Financials and Materials showing relative strength (XLF (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%) ABOVE TREND; Materials (1W: +3.44% | 1M: +8.35%) ABOVE TREND). Key risk: short-term divergences in defensives and select bond ETFs (XLU (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -2.94%) BELOW TREND; LQD (1W: +0.20% | 1M: -0.16%) RECOVERY) that could widen if volatility re-surges.
